pattern_ruling: YES, RECORD IT — one pattern, three instances: ROW-CITES-RECEIPT-THAT-LACKS-THE-ROW'S-NUMERAL. Subclasses (wrong-file vs absent-figure vs absent-total) differ in remedy, not in detection: all three were invisible until a literal-opening check ran, and all three share the cause (reasons written from memory of a number, not from the cited bytes). A pattern with a standing detector (verify-reason-numerals.sh) is more than ledger-only — recommend NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE R-entry naming the pattern AND the gate that now checks it, so the next mispointer meets machinery, not memory. R-entry text offered, not landed (conductor's file).
